1.0.12.en: Added custom site energy icons, a separate home battery device with controls, updated app metadata links, and cleaned up Homey Energy support.

1.0.13.en: Added explicit Home battery flow cards for battery mode, discharge control, SoC limits, grid residual power, grid charge limit, and charge/discharge state automations.

1.0.14.en: Fixed charging session energy being reported in Wh instead of kWh, causing incorrect readings on the Homey Energy dashboard.

1.1.0.en: Added dashboard widgets for live site energy flow and EV charging points, including charging modes, target charge level, session energy, remaining time, and improved light and dark themes.

1.2.0.en: Added compatibility with evcc Smart mode and Always Charge while preserving existing automations, and improved pairing pages with reliable light and dark mode device selection.
